Requirements You're either holding or wearing an alchemist's toolkit and you have a free hand

You create alchemical items quickly using an alchemist's toolkit. Choose either Create Consumable or Quick Vial as your action for Quick Alchemy.

Any effect created by an item made with Quick Alchemy that would have a duration longer than 10 minutes lasts for 10 minutes instead. This excludes afflictions such as slow acting poisons (as described in the infused trait).

Create Consumable

Requirements You have at least one versatile vial

Expend one versatile vial to create a single alchemical consumable item of your level or lower that's in your formula book. Skip the normal monetary cost in alchemical raw materials and the Crafting check. This item has the infused trait and must be activated before the start of your next turn or else it becomes inert.

Quick Vial

Create a volatile vial that can be used only as a bomb or for the volatile vial option from your research field. This item has the infused trait and must be activated by the end of your current turn or else it becomes inert.

Using Quick Vial does not expend a versatile vial.

Module With Quick Alchemy switched on under Alchemist in the Marquiste Additions settings, using this action asks you to choose Quick Vial or Create Consumable. Adding this action to a character also adds the Quick Vial and Create Consumable actions. Create Consumable is shown but cannot be chosen while you have no versatile vial left.
